description: Set behind gates in one of Tarzana's most coveted south of the Boulevard enclaves, this private estate spans nearly half an acre of resort-inspired grounds, offering a rare balance of tranquility, sophistication, and scale. Surrounded by lush landscaping, the property features a pool and spa, scenic views, a two-car garage, and generous additional parking creating an environment that is both impressive and inviting. A dramatic entry introduces approximately 3,436 square feet of thoughtfully remodeled living space, blending modern comfort with timeless design. The home offers three bedrooms, along with an oversized office or flexible living space with a private entrance ideal for a home office, guest suite, or potential fourth bedroom. Filled with natural light, the interiors are enhanced by French doors that open to expansive outdoor areas, creating seamless indoor-outdoor living. The open floor plan is designed for both relaxed living and elegant entertaining, highlighted by high ceilings, engineered wood flooring and well-proportioned living spaces. The main level features a living room with fireplace, a spacious family room opening to a private patio, a powder room, and a large office with its own entrance.  A cozy study with a two-sided fireplace (shared with the Living Room) adds warmth and character. At the center of the home, the dining area flows into a well-appointed gourmet kitchen featuring Calcutta countertops, a center island, eight burner Viking range, Sub-Zero, and Miele appliances. Upstairs, the primary suite offers a serene retreat with sweeping valley views, a private balcony, and a spa-inspired bath with jacuzzi style tub, dual vanities, and a large walk-in closet. Two additional bedrooms and bath complete the upper level. The grounds unfold as a private oasis, thoughtfully designed for both quiet relaxation and effortless entertaining, all within close proximity to El Caballero Country Club and Mulholland Hills Country Club.
